verses.en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.sm: Aperaamo, ua tele ona tausaga; ua faamanuia foi le ALII ia Aperaamo i mea uma.

verses.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Aperaamo i lana auauna o le toeaina o le aiga, sa pwe i ana mea uma, Seʻi sulu mai ia lou lima i lalo o loʻu aloivae;

verses.en: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
verses.sm: ma ia e tauto mai ia te au i le ALII, o le Atua o le lagi, ma le Atua o le lalolagi, e te le au mai se ava a loʻu atalii i fafine o Kanana, o le nuu ou te nofo ai nei.

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
verses.sm: A ia e alu atu i loʻu nuu ma loʻu aiga, ma e au mai ai se ava ma lo‘u atalii o Isaako.

verses.en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o le auauna ia te ia, Pe afai e le mafai le fafine ona ma o mai i le nuu nei, ma te matua o atu ea ma lou atalii i le nuu na e sau ai?

verses.en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Aperaamo ia te ia, Ia oe, neʻi e ave lava loʻu atalii i lea mea.

verses.en: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
verses.sm: O le ALII, o le Atua o le lagi, o le na aumaia aʻu mai le aiga o loʻu tama, ma le nuu o loʻu aiga, o le na fetalai mai foi ia te au, ma na tauto mai ia te au, na faapea mai, Ou te foaiina lenei lava nuu mo lau fanau; e auina atu e ia lava o lana agelu e muamua ia te oe; e te au mai foi se ava ma loʻu atalii ai lea mea.

verses.en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
verses.sm: A e afai e le mafai le fafine ona oulua o mai ma ia, ona e magalo ai lea ai lau tautoga nel; a e aua lava lua te o atu ma loʻu atalii i lea mea.

verses.en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
verses.sm: Ona sulu ai lea e le auauna o lona lima i lalo o le aloivae o Aperaamo lona matai, ma tauto atu ia te ia i lea mea.

verses.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e le auauna O kamela e sefulu, ai kamela a lona matai, ua alu foi o ia ma mea lelei uma a lona matai i lona lima; ua tulai foi o ia, ma alu atu i Mesopotamia i le aai o Nakori.

verses.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia tootuli kamela i tua o le aai, e lata ane i le vaieli, i le afiafi, i le itu aso e O atu ai fafine e utu vai.

verses.en: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o ia, Le Aw e, le Atua o loʻu matai o Aperaamo, ia e faamanuia lava ia te au i le asó, ma e alofa mai foi i loʻu matai o Aperaamo.

verses.en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
verses.sm: Faauta, o aʻu nei, ou te tu i luga o le vaipuna; o le a o mai foi afafine o tagata o le aai e utu vai;

verses.en: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
verses.sm: ia faapea ona fai, o le teine ou te faapea atu i ai, Seʻi e tuutuu ifo lau kate soʻu inu ae; ona faapea mai lea o ia, Ina inu ia, ou te faainua foi au kamela; o le teine lea ua e tofia ma lau auauna 0 Isaako; ou te iloa foi i lea mea ua e alofa mai i lo'u matai.

verses.en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, e lei uma atu lana upu, a ua sau Repeka, o le afafine o Petueli, le tama tane lea a Meleka, le ava a Nakori, o le uso o Aperaamo, sa i lona ua lana kate.

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.sm: O le teine e matua lalelei lava, o le taupou, e lei iloa e ia tane; ua alu ifo o ia i le vai, ua utu ai lana kate, ma toe alu ae.

verses.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
verses.sm: Ona momo'e atu lea o le auauna e faafetaiai ia te ia, ua faapea atu, So'u inu ae sina vai ai lau kate.

verses.en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ia, Le alii e, taumafa ia; ona vave tuu ifo lea e ia o lana kate i lona lima, ma tuu atu ia te ia e inu ai.

verses.en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona avatu ia te ia e inu ona faapea atu lea o ia, Ou te utufia foi ma au kamela, seia latou feinu ai ia malilie.

verses.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.sm: Ona faataalise lea o ia ma sasaa lana kate i le umete, ona toe momo'e ifo lea o ia i le vai e wu ae, i le ua utu ae e ia ma ana kamela uma.

verses.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.sm: O le tagata foi, ua ofo o ia ia te ia; ua faalologo i le fia iloa po ua faamanuia e le ALH lana malaga pe leai.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.sm: Ua uma ona feinu o kamela, ona avatu lea e le tagata o le mama auro, o le vaeluagalemu o le sekeli lona mamafa, ma taulima auro e lua mo ona lima, e sefulu sekeli o lo la mamafa lea;

verses.en: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
verses.sm: ua faapea atu foi o ia, Seʻi e tau mai ia te au, pe se afafine oe o ai? Pe ai ea se mea ile fale o lou tama matou te api ai?

verses.en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o ia ia te ia, O a‘u o le afafine o Petueli o le tama ia a Meleka, na fanau e ia ia Nakori.

verses.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
verses.sm: Ua faapea mai foi o ia ia te ia, O ia i matou “au o saito, ma mea e ‘ai e tele a manu, atoa ma le mea e api ai.

verses.en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona punou lea o le tagata, ma ifo atu i le ALII.

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu foi o ia, Ia faafetaia le ALII, o le Atua o loʻu matai o Aperaamo, o le ua le tuua lona alofa ma lona faamaoni i loʻu matai; na ou i le ala, ona taʻitaʻiina ai lea o aʻu e le ALII i le fale o uso o loʻu matai.

verses.en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
verses.sm: Ona momoʻe lea o le teine, ma taʻu atu ia mea i le aiga o lona tinā.

verses.en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
verses.sm: Sa ia Repeka le tuagane o Lapana lona igoa; ua momoʻe mai foi Lapana i le tagata i le vaipuna.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.sm: U& iloa e ia o le mama auro, ma taulima i lima o lona tuafafine, ua faalogo atu foi i upu a lona tuafafine o Repeka, ua faapea mai, Na faapea ona tautala mai o le tagata ia te au, ona alu lea o ia i le tagata, faauta foi, ua tu o ia ma kamela i luga o le vaipuna.

verses.en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ia, Maliu mai ia o oe ua faamanuia e le Aw; se a le mea ua e tu aji fafo? Auá ua uma ona ou teuteua o le fale, ma le mea e ave i ai kamela.

verses.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
verses.sm: Ona ulufale lea o le tagata i le fale; ona tatalaina lea e Lapana o kamela, ma avane “au o saito ma mea e “ai má kamela, ma vai foi e mulumulu ai ona vae, ma vae O tagata na o mai ma ia.

verses.en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
verses.sm: Ona laulauina mai ai lea ia te ia o mea e ‘ai; a ua faapea atu o ia, Ou te le “ai lava, a seia uma ona ou taʻu atu o laʻu feau. Ona faapea atu lea o ia, Ina taʻu mai ia.

verses.en: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ia, O au o le auauna a Aperaamo.

verses.en: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.sm: Ua faamanuia tele lava e le Aw loʻu matai; ua mamalu lava o ia; ua foaiina foi e ia ia te ia o lafu mamoe, ma lafu povi, ma ario, ma auro, ma auauna tane, ma auauna fafine, ma kamela, atoa ma asini.

verses.en: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.sm: O Sara foi le ava a loʻu matai na fanau e ia le atalii o loʻu matai ina o loomatua ia; ua foaiina atu foi e ia ia te ia o ana mea uma.

verses.en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
verses.sm: O aʻu foi, na ou tauto ina ua fai mai ai o loʻu matai, ua faapea mai, E te le au mai se aya ma lo'u atalii i fafine o Kanana, o le nuu ou te nofo ai nei.

verses.en: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
verses.sm: Á ia e alu atu i le aiga o loʻu tama, ma loʻu aiga, ma au mai ai se aya ma lo'u atalii.

verses.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.sm: Ona ou tali atu lea i loʻu matai, Atonu e le mafai le fafine ona ma o mai.

verses.en: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai lea o ia ia te au, O le ALII, o loo savali a‘u nei i ona luma, e awna atu e ia lana agelu lua te.o faatasi ma ia, na te faamanuia ai lau malaga; e te au mai foi se ava ma lo‘u atalii mai lo'u aiga, ma le aiga o lo'u tama.

verses.en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.sm: E te magalo i lau tauto, pe a e oo i loʻu aiga; afai foi latou te le tuuna mai se tasi ia te oe, ona e magalo ai lea i lau tauto.

verses.en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.sm: Na ou sau foi i le aso nei i le vaipuna, ma ou faapea atu, Le ALII e, le Atua o loʻu matai o Aperaamo, afai e te faamanuia lava laʻu malaga ua ou sau ai;

verses.en: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
verses.sm: faauta, o aʻu nei, ou te tu i luga o le vaipuna, ia faapea ona fai, o le taupou e sau e utu vai, ma ou faapea atu i ai, se’i au mai sina vai, soʻu inu ae ai lau kate;

verses.en: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.
verses.sm: ona tali mai lea o ia ia te au, Ina inu ia oe, ou te utufia foi ma au kamela; o le avā lea ua, tofia e le Aw: ma le atalii o loʻu matai.

verses.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.sm: Na le uma foi ona ou faapea ifo i loʻu loto, faauta, ua sau Repeka, ua faafuata mai lana kate; ona alu ifo lea o ia i le vaipuna ma utu ae ai; ona ou faapea atu lea ia te ia, So'u inu ae.

verses.en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.sm: Ona vave tuu ifo lea e ia o lana kate, ma faapea mai, Ina inu ia; ou te faainua foi au kamela; ona ou inu lea; na faainua foi e ia o kamela.

verses.en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.sm: Ona ou fesili atu lea ia te ia, Pe se afafine oe o ai? Ona tali mai lea o ia, O le afafine o Petueli le atalii o Nakori, sa fanau ia te ia e Meleka; ona ou tuu atu lea o le mama i lona fofoga, ma taulima i ona'lima.

verses.en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
verses.sm: Ona ou punou lea, ma ifo atu i le ALII, ma faafetai atu i le An le Atua o lo'u matai o Aperaamo, o le na ta‘ita‘i ia te au i le ala tonu, e au mai le afafine o le uso o loʻu matai e fai ma avá a lona atalii.

verses.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, tou te taʻu mai, pe tou te alofa ma faamaoni i loʻu matai; a e afai e leai, taʻu mai ia te au, ina ia ou faasaga i le itu taumatau poo le itu tauagavale.

verses.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Lapana ma Petuell, ua faapea mai, Ua tupu mai i le Aw: lena mea; ma te le mafai ona fai atu ia te oe i sona lelei po o sona leaga.

verses.en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.sm: Faauta, o Repeka o i ou luma ia; ina o ia oulua ma ia, ia fai o ia ma avā a le atalii o lou matai, e pei ona fetalai mai ai o le Aw.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo atu le auauna a Aperaamo i a la upu, ona ifo toele lea o ia i le ALII.

verses.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.sm: Ona au mai lea e le auauna o teuga ario, ma teuga auro, atoa ma ofu, ma avatu ia Repeka; ua ia foai atu foi i lona tuagane ma lona tinā o oloa táua.

verses.en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
verses.sm: Ona latou aai ai lea ma inu, O ia ma tagata na latou o mai ma ia, ona latou momoe ai lea; ua latou tulai foi i le taeao, ona faapea atu lea o ia, Tuu mai ia te au ia ou alu atu i loʻu matai.

verses.en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o lona tuagane ma lona tinā, Seʻi matou nonofo ma le teine i ni aso pe toe sefulu; a mavae mai ia, i le alu ai o ia.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o ia ia te i laua, Aua lua te taofi ia te au, auā ua faamanuia mai e le ALII laʻu malaga; tuu mai ia te au ja ou alu atu i loʻu matai.

verses.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o i laua, Seʻi ma valaauina ane Je teine, ma fesili atu pe se a lona loto.

verses.en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
verses.sm: Ona valaau ane lea o i laua ia Repeka, ua faapea atu foi ia te ia, Lua te o ea ma le alii nei? Ona tali mai lea o ia, Ma te o.

verses.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
verses.sm: Ona latou tuuina atu lea o Repeka lo latou tuafafine, ma le na tausi ia te ia, ma le auauna a Aperaamo, atoa ma ona tagata.

verses.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
verses.sm: Ua latou faamanuia atu foi ia Repeka, ua faapea atu ia te ia, O oe o lo matou tuafafine, ia avea oe ma tinā o afe e mano, ia maua foi e lau fanau o faitotoa o e ita mai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Repeka, ma ona teine, ma latou tietie i kamela, ma mulimuli atu i le tagata; ua au mai Repeka e le auauna a Aperaamo, ona latou o ai lea.

verses.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.
verses.sm: Ua sau foi Isaako i le ala e ui i Perelaaroi, auā sa mau o ia i le nuu i le itu i toga.

verses.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu foi Isaako i le fanua i le afiafi e mafaufau ai; ua tepa ae foi o ia ma iloa atu, faauta foi, O kamela ua o mai.

verses.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
verses.sm: Ua tepa ae foi Repeka ua na iloa atu ia Isaako, ona alu ifo lea o ia i le kamela.

verses.en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
verses.sm: Auā na ia fesili atu i le auauna, O ai lena tagata lē savali mai i le fanua e faafetaiai ia te i tatou? Na tali mai foi le auauna, O loʻu matai ia. Ona tago ai lea o ia i le ufiufi mata, ma ufi ifo ai ia te ia.

verses.en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
verses.sm: Ua faamatalaina atu foi e le auauna ia Isaako mea uma lava na faia e ia.

verses.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
verses.sm: Ona taʻitaʻi atu lea e Isaako ia te ia i le fale ie o lona tinā o Sara, ua ave e ja o Repeka, ua fai foi o ia ma ana aya; ua fiafia foi o ia ia te ia; ona faatoa faamafan
